name: Ozem
overview: Ozem was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Jerahmeel. His identity is grounded in his lineage within the tribe of Judah, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:25. There are no additional notes or details provided about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Ozem appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as Ozem in 1 Chronicles 2:25, with no further explanation of its significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ozem as the son of Jerahmeel, establishing his place within the genealogical line of Judah. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are mentioned.
scriptureSignificance: Ozem's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of Judah, which trace the lineage of God's chosen people.
